issues.description: Expose a checkout flag so guests can complete an order without an account.
issues.acceptance: Given a guest cart, when they checkout, then the guest flag is stored on the order.

issues.summary: Remember shipping address on guest checkout
issues.description: Persist the last shipping address for a returning guest browser.
issues.acceptance: Given a guest who already checked out, when they return, then shipping fields are prefilled.

issues.summary: Block checkout when inventory is exhausted
issues.description: Refuse submit if any line item has zero sellable stock.
issues.acceptance: Given a cart with an out-of-stock SKU, when checkout is submitted, then an error is shown.

issues.description: Display estimated tax on the review step using the shipping postal code.
issues.acceptance: Given a shipping postal code, when the review step loads, then estimated tax is visible.

issues.description: Emit start, address, payment, and complete events for the checkout funnel.
issues.acceptance: Given a completed checkout, when analytics is queried, then four funnel events exist.

issues.description: Never store PAN; send tokens from the payment iframe.
issues.acceptance: Given a card payment, when the order is saved, then only a token is stored.

issues.description: Retry a single authorization timeout with the same idempotency key.
issues.acceptance: Given a timeout from the processor, when checkout retries, then only one extra authorize is sent.

issues.description: Map processor decline codes to shopper-safe messages.
issues.acceptance: Given decline code 51, when payment fails, then the shopper sees insufficient funds.

issues.summary: Add store credit as a tender type
issues.description: Allow store credit to cover part or all of an order.
issues.acceptance: Given store credit balance, when applied, then the remaining due drops by that amount.

issues.description: Hide SKUs that cannot ship from the selected node.
issues.acceptance: Given a node without SKU A, when the catalog loads, then SKU A is omitted.

issues.description: Show New and Last chance badges from catalog attributes.
issues.acceptance: Given a SKU with badge=new, when the PDP loads, then a New badge is visible.

issues.description: Add brand synonym pairs to the search dictionary.
issues.acceptance: Given synonym Acme→Example, when a shopper searches Acme, then Example products appear.

issues.summary: Cache category trees for five minutes
issues.description: Reduce origin load for the browse tree.
issues.acceptance: Given a repeated category request within five minutes, when served, then the cache header is HIT.

issues.description: Send a dispatched email with carrier and tracking id.
issues.acceptance: Given a dispatched shipment, when the event is processed, then the shopper receives one email.

issues.description: Send confirmation SMS only when the shopper opted in.
issues.acceptance: Given opt-in=false, when an order is placed, then no SMS is sent.

issues.description: Show a dismissible banner after a declined payment.
issues.acceptance: Given a declined payment, when the shopper returns to cart, then a failure banner is shown.

issues.description: Nightly CSV of refunds for the prior day.
issues.acceptance: Given refunds yesterday, when the job runs, then a CSV is written with those rows.

issues.description: Only merchandisers can override list price.
issues.acceptance: Given a support user, when they open price override, then the action is hidden.

issues.description: Record who published a catalog snapshot.
issues.acceptance: Given a publish, when audit is queried, then actor and timestamp are present.

issues.description: A second click created duplicate orders.

issues.summary: Correct tax rounding on split tenders
issues.description: Pennies were lost when mixing store credit and card.
Cancelled captures were retried overnight.
